acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce each of the three degradations with load averages and counts, or refute; for each reproduced one, either the hook path stays within its deadline at load ~50 or the degradation is reported with an actionable cause; tests plus one mutation per fix.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-0500 lane (PR #925, evidence docs/experiments/v1-0500-live-handoff-20261015.json, diagnostics.hostAdapterLedgerRows) at load 50-67: Claude Code adapter logged adapter-host-kill-deadline; both Claude Code and Codex logged corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-deadline; Codex logged corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-index-snapshot-stale. The orchestrator session also sees dogfood-event-deadline and prompt-over-query-bound FALLBACK on most prompts at load 35-60. V1-1120 covers dogfood-event-deadline for Frontier Stop only; adapter-host-kill-deadline and index-snapshot-stale have no ticket. Expected: hook events complete within their bound at this load or degrade with a specific, actionable reason; Actual: events rejected, hosts get no Corvint context.
title: Host adapters degrade under load: adapter-host-kill-deadline and dogfood-event-index-snapshot-stale (beyond V1-1120)
